review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 6 retail bytes, 2 instructions, 1 block, 0 edges; candidate 1/0 at CFG 1.000.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: No ABI arguments: the routine takes void and reads no stack slot.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: One constant: the block address 0x005BDDB0. No offset, scale or conversion applied.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: No memory access at all - the address is materialised in eax and returned. The extent used for the block object (0x3C) comes from the writer at 0x0046B4E9, not from this body.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call and no store: the only effect is the returned pointer, so there is no side effect to compare.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry, one exit: the ret at +5. No branch, no early return and no error path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point instruction; the body moves an integer address.

runtime_contract.scope: paired retail/candidate observation of the published block address during level-1 startup

limitations: Runtime not yet paired: the candidate exits at 0x00402930 before any game native runs.
The block's meaning is not established; 0x3C is a proven lower bound for its extent, not a claim about the full object size.
